items.text: In a game, tap Ordi for a rules question: the orb now shows a “?”, and the chat opens full screen.
Choosing how you’re playing now brings the expansions into view, so they’re easy to find.
Before each guide, Ordi offers to help with the table setup, or to skip straight to round 1.
Dune: leaving the Harkonnen dice turns is now a big button, so the guide moves on to the next round.
The Game menu can skip to the next phase when your table is ahead of the guide.
Playing on your own phones: share an invite link, see who has joined, and get back to your table after closing the app.
Fixed: switching on an expansion no longer freezes the screen on Android phones.
“What’s new”, under Help, lists everything Ordi fixed and improved lately.
Fixed: words Ordi puts in bold in its answers now show in bold, without stars.
New game: Terraforming Mars, with Prelude, Venus Next, Colonies, Turmoil and the Hellas & Elysium maps.
Home now opens with Ordi’s newest game and current favorites.
Ordir Pro is coming soon, with more rules questions and Ordi in shades.
Report a problem from Account or the Game menu, with a screenshot if you like.
Fixed: the Home Screen app now opens the latest version, not an older copy.
